title: Answer the requests the authorizer can't take

cases.says: a purchase with an amount goes on to the authorizer and the terminal gets its approval
an authorization with an amount goes on to the authorizer and the terminal gets its approval
a refused request still gets its response, because the response is in the Context before the participant votes ABORTED
the refusal is built from the request, so it carries the STAN and terminal ID the terminal matches it by
a network message carries no amount and is not refused for it
the response is a copy, so the request in the Context keeps its MTI and gets no response code

origin.section: 1.4 A Participant Decides in `prepare`, and an Abort Still Answers
